violation_type.title: Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers (26 TAC §746.2415(a)(1))
violation_type.short_title: Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers
violation_type.typical_finding: An infant was observed in a walker in the infant       Note: The infant was removed and placed in the bouncer.

finding_variants.text: An infant was observed in a walker in the infant       Note: The infant was removed and placed in the bouncer.
During the walkthrough of the operation, two walkers with wheels were oberved in the infant classroom.
Three baby walkers were observed in the infant classroom. This was corrected at inspection when the walkers were removed.

An infant was observed utilizing a walker with wheels that would allow movement. Walkers are prohibited equipment and would allow infants to move around and have access to materials or may cause a hand injury to other infants during floor time. The deficiency was corrected during the inspection when the staff removed the infant out of the equipment and removed the prohibited equipment out of the classroom with CCR brought it to their attention.
The operation had a baby walker in the infant classroom.
There was an infant sitting on a baby walker equipment in the infant room.     Note, this was corrected at inspection.
